items.source: scope - the scope identifier
items.translation: scope - 作用域标识符

items.source: name - the name of the attribute
items.translation: name - 属性的名称

items.source: Note that 'destruction' usually corresponds to destruction of the entire scope, not to the individual attribute having been explicitly removed by the application. If an attribute gets removed via this facade's removeAttribute(String, int) method, any registered destruction callback should be disabled as well, assuming that the removed object will be reused or manually destroyed.
items.translation: 注意，'销毁'通常对应整个作用域的销毁，而不是应用程序显式移除了单个属性。如果通过此外观的 removeAttribute(String, int) 方法移除属性，则应同时禁用任何已注册的销毁回调，假设被移除的对象将被重用或手动销毁。

items.source:
Can be implemented for any kind of request/session mechanism,
in particular for servlet requests.
items.translation: 可应用于任何类型的请求/会话机制，特别是 Servlet 请求。

items.source:
This preferably refers to a locally isolated session, if such
a distinction is available.
Else, it simply refers to the common session.
items.translation: 这最好是指本地隔离的会话，如果存在此类区分的话。否则，它仅指通用会话。

items.source: Name of the standard reference to the request object: "request".
items.translation: 标准参考名称为请求对象："request"。

items.source: Name of the standard reference to the session object: "session".
items.translation: 会话对象的标准引用名称："session"。

items.source: Constant that indicates request scope.
items.translation: 指示请求范围的常量。

items.source: Return the value for the scoped attribute of the given name, if any.
items.translation: 返回给定名称的 scoped 属性的值（如果有的话）。

items.source: Retrieve the names of all attributes in the scope.
items.translation: 检索作用域中所有属性的名称。

items.source: Return an id for the current underlying session.
items.translation: 返回当前底层会话的 ID。

items.source:
Expose the best available mutex for the underlying session:
that is, an object to synchronize on for the underlying session.
items.translation: 暴露底层会话可用的最佳互斥锁：即用于同步底层会话的对象。

items.source:
Set the value for the scoped attribute of the given name,
replacing an existing value (if any).
items.translation: 为给定名称的 scoped 属性设置值，替换现有值（如果有）。

items.source: Note that an implementation should also remove a registered destruction callback for the specified attribute, if any. It does, however, not need to execute a registered destruction callback in this case, since the object will be destroyed by the caller (if appropriate).
items.translation: 注意，实现还应移除为指定属性注册的销毁回调（如果有）。然而，在这种情况下，它确实不需要执行已注册的销毁回调，因为对象将由调用者销毁（如果适用）。

items.source: Implementations should do their best to execute the callback at the appropriate time: that is, at request completion or session termination, respectively. If such a callback is not supported by the underlying runtime environment, the callback must be ignored and a corresponding warning should be logged.
items.translation: 实现应尽力在适当的时间执行回调：即在请求完成或会话终止时，分别如此。如果底层运行环境不支持此类回调，则必须忽略该回调并记录相应的警告。

items.source: NOTE: Callback objects should generally be serializable if they are being registered for a session scope. Otherwise the callback (or even the entire session) might not survive web app restarts.
items.translation: 注意：如果回调对象被注册为会话范围，它们通常应该是可序列化的。否则，回调（甚至整个会话）可能无法在 Web 应用程序重启后存活。

items.source:
At a minimum: the HttpServletRequest reference for key "request", and
the HttpSession reference for key "session".
items.translation: 至少：键为"request"的 HttpServletRequest 引用，以及键为"session"的 HttpSession 引用。

items.source: Constant that indicates session scope.
items.translation: 表示会话范围的常量。

items.source:
Register a callback to be executed on destruction of the
specified attribute in the given scope.
items.translation: 在给定范围内注册回调，以便在指定属性销毁时执行。

items.source: Remove the scoped attribute of the given name, if it exists.
items.translation: 如果存在，请移除给定名称的 scoped 属性。

items.source: Resolve the contextual reference for the given key, if any.
items.translation: 解析给定键的上下文引用（如有）。

items.source: the current attribute value, or null if not found
items.translation: 当前属性值，如果未找到则为null

items.source: value - the value for the attribute
items.translation: value - 属性的值

items.source: name - the name of the attribute to register the callback for
items.translation: name - 要注册回调的属性的名称

items.source: callback - the destruction callback to be executed
items.translation: callback - 要执行的销毁回调

items.source: key - the contextual key
items.translation: key - 上下文键

items.source: the corresponding object, or null if none found
items.translation: 对应的对象，如果未找到则为null

items.source: the session id as String (never null)
items.translation: 会话 ID 作为 String（永远不为null）

items.source: the session mutex to use (never null)
items.translation: 要使用的会话互斥锁（永远不能为null）

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller

items.source: the attribute names as String array
items.translation: 将属性名称作为字符串数组。

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
